release_notes: OLED 2.42 beta build 99. Rebuilds lost-Wi-Fi recovery around one clean scan of all stored profiles every five seconds and explicitly connects to a visible stored SSID regardless of RSSI, including signals weaker than -85 dBm. Removes the blind reconnect that could leave the ESP32 station stuck in a connecting state, keeps an otherwise connected Wi-Fi link intact through transient Nightscout errors, and restarts the local alias after recovery. Current status now hides Trend FIFO and cloud/task diagnostics unless Advanced technical settings is enabled, shows the local buzzer master as a compact status-grid control box, and places four-hour trend backfill under OLED screen controls. A short right-button release snoozes; ARM now fires while the button remains held at three seconds and OFF fires while it remains held at ten seconds, with three-second confirmation screens. Retains Build 98 responsive live OTA progress and verified installation.
